INSERT INTO actionnow.whatsapp_media_interpretations (
  media_id, message_id, owner_email, owner_phone_num,
  interpretation_type, content, status, model_provider, model_name
)
SELECT
  wm.id, wm.message_id, wm.owner_email, wm.owner_phone_num,
  'transcript', $1, 'done', 'openrouter', 'google/chirp-3'
FROM actionnow.whatsapp_message_media wm
WHERE wm.message_id = $2
ON CONFLICT (media_id, interpretation_type) DO UPDATE SET
  content = EXCLUDED.content,
  status = 'done',
  model_provider = EXCLUDED.model_provider,
  model_name = EXCLUDED.model_name,
  error_message = NULL,
  updated_date = now()
RETURNING id, interpretation_type, content;

INSERT INTO actionnow.whatsapp_media_interpretations (
  media_id, message_id, owner_email, owner_phone_num,
  interpretation_type, content, status, model_provider, model_name
)
SELECT
  wm.id, wm.message_id, wm.owner_email, wm.owner_phone_num,
  t.itype, $1, 'done', 'openrouter', $2
FROM actionnow.whatsapp_message_media wm
CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('caption'), ('ocr')) AS t(itype)
WHERE wm.message_id = $3
ON CONFLICT (media_id, interpretation_type) DO UPDATE SET
  content = EXCLUDED.content,
  status = 'done',
  model_provider = EXCLUDED.model_provider,
  model_name = EXCLUDED.model_name,
  error_message = NULL,
  updated_date = now()
RETURNING id, interpretation_type, left(content, 80) AS preview;

parameters.query:
SELECT *
FROM actionnow.user_whatsapp_connections
WHERE (
  NULLIF(TRIM($1::text), '') IS NOT NULL AND webhook_secret = TRIM($1::text)
) OR (
  NULLIF(TRIM($2::text), '') IS NOT NULL AND wasender_session_id::text = TRIM($2::text)
)
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM($1::text), '') IS NOT NULL AND webhook_secret = TRIM($1::text) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT *
FROM actionnow.monitor_settings
WHERE owner_email = $1
ORDER BY created_date DESC
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO actionnow.whatsapp_messages (
  owner_email, owner_phone_num, event_type, whatsapp_timestamp,
  message_id, from_me, chat_jid, is_group, addressing_mode,
  sender_pn, cleaned_sender_pn, sender_lid,
  participant, participant_pn, cleaned_participant_pn, participant_lid,
  sender_phone, sender_lid_resolved,
  message_body, content_type, content_fingerprint, raw_payload, has_media, media_processing_status
) VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, NULLIF($4, '')::bigint, $5, $6::boolean, $7, $8::boolean, NULLIF($9, ''),
  NULLIF($10, ''), NULLIF($11, ''), NULLIF($12, ''),
  NULLIF($13, ''), NULLIF($14, ''), NULLIF($15, ''), NULLIF($16, ''),
  NULLIF($17, ''), NULLIF($18, ''),
  NULLIF($19, ''), $20, NULLIF($21, ''), $22::jsonb, $23::boolean, $24
)
ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING message_id;

INSERT INTO actionnow.whatsapp_message_media (
  owner_email, owner_phone_num, message_id, media_kind, mime_type,
  file_name, file_size, caption, encrypted_url, media_key,
  storage_bucket, decrypt_status
) VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, $4, NULLIF($5, ''), NULLIF($6, ''), NULLIF($7, '')::bigint,
  NULLIF($8, ''), NULLIF($9, ''), NULLIF($10, ''), 'action-now', 'pending'
)
ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO UPDATE SET
  mime_type = EXCLUDED.mime_type,
  file_name = EXCLUDED.file_name,
  file_size = EXCLUDED.file_size,
  caption = EXCLUDED.caption,
  encrypted_url = EXCLUDED.encrypted_url,
  media_key = EXCLUDED.media_key,
  updated_date = now()
RETURNING id, message_id, media_kind;

parameters.query:
UPDATE actionnow.whatsapp_message_media
SET
  decrypt_public_url = NULLIF($1, ''),
  decrypt_status = CASE WHEN NULLIF($1, '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'decrypted' WHEN NULLIF($3, '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'failed' ELSE 'failed' END,
  decrypt_expires_at = CASE WHEN NULLIF($1, '') IS NOT NULL THEN now() + interval '1 hour' ELSE NULL END,
  error_message = COALESCE(NULLIF($3, ''), CASE WHEN NULLIF($1, '') IS NULL THEN 'decrypt API did not return publicUrl' ELSE NULL END),
  updated_date = now()
WHERE message_id = $2;

UPDATE actionnow.whatsapp_messages
SET media_processing_status = CASE WHEN NULLIF($1, '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'processing' ELSE 'failed' END
WHERE message_id = $2;

UPDATE actionnow.whatsapp_message_media
SET
  storage_bucket = 'action-now',
  storage_path = $1,
  storage_url = $2,
  decrypt_status = 'stored',
  updated_date = now()
WHERE message_id = $3;

UPDATE actionnow.whatsapp_messages
SET media_processing_status = 'done'
WHERE message_id = $3;
